in_hebrew.name: Lilas
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lilas הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'lilas', meaning 'lily'. In Greek mythology, the lily was a symbol of purity and innocence. In Christianity, the lily is a symbol of the Virgin Mary and her purity.

in_greek.name: Lilas
in_greek.long_meaning: Lilas είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'lilas', meaning 'lily'. In Greek mythology, the lily was a symbol of purity and innocence. In Christianity, the lily is a symbol of the Virgin Mary and her purity.

in_latin.name: Lilas
in_latin.long_meaning: Lilas est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek word 'lilas', meaning 'lily'. In Greek mythology, the lily was a symbol of purity and innocence. In Christianity, the lily is a symbol of the Virgin Mary and her purity.
